stages.title: bare app
stages.narrative: praxis-pet exists: a tiny tamagotchi CLI with unit tests and nothing else — no grounding, no board, no specs. This is any real project the day before the PDLC arrives.

stages.title: grounded
stages.narrative: The project is grounded: a research vault branch (research/Virtual-Pet-Mechanics — cited, neutral notes on the domain) and a code-grounded wiki (docs/wiki — 5 notes pinned to the stage-0 commit, CAPSULES rollup). The freshness gate now guards prose against code drift.

stages.title: planned
stages.narrative: Work is planned as specs: a Backlog board with three tasks, each linked to a hand-authored Spec Kit spec dir (specs/001-003) via spec-bridge, plus a signed-off mini sweep runbook. task-3 (--version flag, one file) is the live demo thread — pre-specced and UNMERGED here.

ladder.label: stage-0
ladder.message: praxis-pet: tiny tamagotchi CLI — state machine, JSON store, node:test suite

ladder.label: stage-1
ladder.message: ground: research vault (Virtual-Pet-Mechanics) + docs/wiki built, pinned to stage-0

ladder.label: stage-2
ladder.message: plan: board + specs 001-003 linked via spec-bridge, mini sweep runbook signed off
